items.question: Do you only work with certain marketplaces?
items.answer: We support multi-channel sellers and can tailor listing and fulfillment workflows to your primary platforms.

items.question: How quickly can inventory go live?
items.answer: Most brands are live within 10–14 days after intake, depending on catalog size and listing scope.

items.question: Can you handle custom packaging?
items.answer: Yes. We offer branded inserts, kitting, and special handling to match your unboxing experience.

items.question: What reporting do you provide?
items.answer: You receive weekly operational snapshots and monthly performance reviews covering stock, fulfillment, and listing metrics.
